_readme: Ground truth for the benchmark. Copy to expectations.json and fill in.
One entry per image FILENAME in benchmark/images/.
'expected' = foods you can actually see. Lowercase Croatian, generic names
('tjestenina', not 'tjestenina s umakom'), because that is what the
model is instructed to emit and what matchFood.ts compares against.
'isFood': false marks a control image the model must REJECT.
Grading is substring-based in both directions, so 'krumpir' matches
'pečeni krumpir'. Anything returned that matches no expected item is
counted as a hallucination — keep 'expected' complete.

14-laptop.jpg.note: NON-FOOD control — must return isFood:false / no items
